description: This file defines the Zone entity class used to model geographical zones associated with countries in the system. It includes fields for ID, code, descriptions, associated country, and name, with appropriate JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Entity class representing a geographical zone with references to country and descriptions, mapped to the ZONE table in the database schema.

methods.name: Zone
methods.description: Default constructor for the Zone class.

methods.name: Zone
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing Zone with a country, name, and code.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the associated Country object for the zone.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the associated Country object for the zone.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the unique code of the zone.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the unique code of the zone.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the zone, overrides method from SalesManagerEntity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the zone, overrides method from SalesManagerEntity.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for the zone.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the zone.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the zone.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the zone.
